summary: Wall-clock thresholds (values unchanged) are judged only with PANTHEON_SOURCE_INGEST_WALL_CLOCK_BOUNDS=1. Only bounds whose observed maximum over 30 runs under load exceeded half of the bound are gated; each gated bound has a counter in the default required check. No production code changed.

load_definitions.idle: serial, one run at a time, on the shared 12-core dev host (other workers present, load average 2.4-5 during these runs); this is the quietest this host gets
load_definitions.loaded_snapshot_store: 3 concurrent copies of the test on the same host (shared disk), no extra spinners
load_definitions.loaded_fast_files: one round = 10 pytest processes (the files below) at once on the same host, 30 rounds
load_definitions.loaded_default_path: 8 concurrent pytest processes + 4 CPU spinner loops + 1 fsync dd loop (64 MB oflag=dsync), 200 runs
